title: Three Against Three
setup: Six pawns face each other on the kingside while both kings stand a whole board away.
hint: Neither king can arrive in time, so look for a pawn move that opens a lane by giving material away.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{g6}} is the only winning move, and it hands a pawn over. {{hxg6}} {{f6}} {{gxf6}} {{h6}} and the h-pawn cannot be caught; if Black takes the other way the same break works with the f-pawn. Quiet moves draw, and several of them lose to the identical idea.
